title: rewards.points.expiring_soon v1
description: Notice that a member's points will expire soon (ADR-001 v2 of alebrije-mod-rewards-go, D2, fase 1.6). Source: alebrije-mod-rewards-go, ExpirationWorker.sweepRepo -> repo.NotifyExpiringPoints (internal/repo/expiry_notices.go) -> emitExpiringSoon (internal/service/expiration.go), written to the rewards outbox in the SAME transaction as the rewards.points_expiry_notices row (migration 0028), and relayed by the alebrije-common-go outbox poller onto the enveloped events:rewards domain stream -- the shape this schema describes. One notice per member for the nearest expiry inside the tenant's window (rewards.tenant_settings.expiry_warning_days, default 7, 0 = off); idempotency key rewards.points.expiring_soon:<user_id>:<expires_on>. rewards sends no message itself: each tenant's cadences (alebrije-mod-cadences-ex, consumer group cadences-ex-enrollment-rewards) decide what to say, with the tenant's Meta template (ADR-152). contact_id / contact_phone are the member's CRM contact and canonical phone (ADR-142), present when known; cadences enrols by contact_id, or by phone when there is no contact_id.

user_id.description: Rewards member id (points_accounts.user_id = rewards.members.id, ADR-001 v2 D1).

contact_id.description: The member's CRM contact, when the member is linked to one. Absent otherwise.

contact_phone.description: The member's canonical phone (ADR-142, E.164 digits without '+'). Absent when unknown.

amount.description: Points that expire inside the warning window, capped at the member's available balance (the same cap the FIFO expiry applies when it revokes them).

metadata.description: When the points expire: expires_at to show (in the tenant's timezone), expires_on to dedup.

expires_at.description: RFC3339 UTC instant the nearest of these points expire. Format it in the tenant's timezone before showing it to the member.

expires_on.description: UTC date of expires_at: the dedup key of the notice, not a display value.

occurred_at.description: When the sweep that emitted the notice ran.
